title: An fppf covering admits an etale-local finite locally free refinement
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and let $\{f_i:S_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ be a small fppf covering [def-pc-fppf-site]. There exist a small jointly surjective family of etale morphisms $e_a:S\prime_a\to S$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], surjective finite locally free morphisms $p_a:V_a\to S\prime_a$ [def-weil-surjective-morphism, def-pc-finite-locally-free], indices $i(a)\in I$, and morphisms $r_a:V_a\to S_{i(a)}$ such that $f_{i(a)}\circ r_a=e_a\circ p_a$ for every $a$. Empty schemes and empty indexing families are allowed.
